newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet sets technology centre in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Valmet sets technology centre in Thailand.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said on Tuesday it would set up a centre for paper machine technology in Thailand with production due to start in late 1997.

"Valmet will be offering to the paper industry in Thailand and the neighbouring regions fully comprehensive services related to the running and operating of paper machines," Valmet said in a statement. The centre will be in Laem Chabang, near Bangkok.
Valmet said the industry in Thailand has expanded strongly in recent years and that it had supplied a significant share of new paper machines.
The new centre will be part of Valmet's service business group, which has also grown fast recently and in 1995 made up nearly 20 percent of Valmet's total net sales of 8.6 billion markka.
